speech.heard: In Uganda, 10.6% of men use the Internet. In Saudi Arabia, it is 100%. Uganda sits at the very bottom of the data, the lowest of all 109. This indicator refers to male individuals who have used the Internet in the last three months. India has 76.7%. China is close with 77.6%. Brazil has 85.2%. That is eight times the rate of Uganda. Climbing higher, Iceland has 99.7%, Denmark has 99.7%, and Kuwait has 99.6%. Saudi Arabia and the UAE have reached the very top at 100%. How much internet do the men around you use?
